title: Windwalker
problem: Counts the damaged creature's own dodges (text: all your creatures).
notes: In-game test:  Fix: H | 2026-10-26 realign (text is the contract): text claims "for each time all your creatures dodged". H: Windwalker (bc_EventDamage L181): count the side's total dodges, not the damaged creature's own. vs bugged: stronger. Batch R: not built. Summing total_dodges over the side needs array iteration of crits / enemies from C (runtime array access helper not yet mapped). Round-2 hook (A2): the damaged creature's total_dodges read (bc_EventDamage L181) returns your party's total dodges. In-game test: Windwalker: let several of your creatures dodge, then check a creature that dodged little: its avoid chance follows the party's total (5% per dodge, max 80%).

release_notes.intended: 5% chance (up to 80%) to avoid damage for each time all your creatures dodged this battle.
release_notes.actual: The game only counted the dodges of the creature being hit.
release_notes.fix: Now the dodges of your whole party count.
